source_text: The origins of voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs in Africa trace to three randomized controlled trials conducted between 2005 and 2007, which demonstrated that adult male circumcision reduces the risk of HIV acquisition by approximately 60% among heterosexual men in high-prevalence settings.
